name: HAC++ Training Process & Sampling Strategy
definition: A staged training procedure with a sampling strategy to stabilize entropy model training and prevent out-of-memory issues in 3D Gaussian Splatting compression.
summary: HAC++ Training Process & Sampling Strategy is a staged method for 3D Gaussian Splatting compression that decouples geometric fitting from entropy coding and samples only 5% of anchors per iteration to prevent out-of-memory errors.
